caption: Are we still allowed to ask questions? 👀 let’s see if this attempt works…
implied_frame: Reposts a Benjamin Fulford (ex-Forbes Asia bureau chief) interview clip claiming Japan's finance ministry was coerced under threat of a HAARP 'earthquake machine,' tied to the 2007 Chuetsu quake that hit the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear plant. Fulford, Takenaka, HAARP, and the 2007 nuclear-plant quake are all real; HAARP earthquake-generation is the unproven, contested claim. Logged as 2007-haarp-earthquake-claim-001.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
video_download_status: Original pulled via yt-dlp (~14.8 MB); delivery ~15.3 MB webm, 91s.
